messages:
Maria Chen: Quick check — noticed a 3–5ms tail increase on long-KV paged-attn when we enabled the fused FlashAttention kernels on the T4 pool. :thinking:
Jordan Patel: Can you drop the perf link + PR so I can triage?
perf-bot: alert: tail_latency_p99.9 increased by 18% for model/redwood-v3@commit abc123 — https://perf.internal/runs/9876 :rotating_light:
Maria Chen: here's the microbench I ran:
```
./bench/run_attention --model redwood-v3 --seq-len 4096 --batch 8 --kv-stream paged --kernel flash_fused --dtype fp16
```
Maria Chen: Output shows p99 ~84ms (baseline ~79ms). Small but consistent across runs.
Lee Ramos: FYI PR #3421 touched the kernel merge and changed memcpy ordering — https://git.redwood/repo/pull/3421. Could be related.
Anita K.: I can run a sweep from EU infra this afternoon. Which matrix do you want? seq_lens [2k,4k,8k,16k], batches [1,4,8], fp16 vs q4, prefetch on/off?
Maria Chen: Yes — that matrix + one run with `--kv-cache=disabled` to capture coldstart. Please tag each job with commit sha and GPU model.
Jordan Patel: I'll add a canary job in CI and assign reviewers. Can you add `--trace-nvtx` to long runs so we can correlate memcpy spikes?
Maria Chen: done — added flag and a small wrapper. Also opened PR #3430 with the job YAML. /cc @Lee Ramos :eyes:
Lee Ramos: I'll review PR #3430 and kick the canary runs after approval. ETA ~2h.
perf-bot: scheduled: canary runs for commits abc123, def456 at 16:00 UTC — https://perf.internal/canaries/215
Anita K.: started the sweep (running 4k/8k/16k with batch 1/4/8; fp16 and q4; prefetch toggled). Posting quick notes here when each stage finishes.
Maria Chen: thanks — if p99 remains high we should be able to flip the kernel-fuse toggle for canary only to validate rollback before wider rollout.
Jordan Patel: confirmed — runtime has a kernel_fuse boolean flag and a fast rollback route. I'll prepare a patch to toggle for the canary.
Anita K.: quick early find — q4 + prefetch looks fine; fp16 + prefetch shows memcpy spikes at the same time as p99 blips. nvprof traces attached to job.
Maria Chen: that points to ordering in the fused path. I'll add instrumentation around the memcpy/pack steps.
Lee Ramos: :thumbsup: keep updates here. if you hit infra limits ping eng-oncall and I can move runs to another pool.
